purpose: Exploratory domain-related versus cross-domain zero-shot transfer; group membership declared from task descriptions, not model gains
historical_status: Reuses previously inspected development datasets. Independent of the synthetic starting weights, but not a fresh confirmatory benchmark.

clinical.definition: Clinical measurement based disease/risk classification from independently sourced cohorts; broad domain hypothesis, not a similarity metric

financial.definition: Creditworthiness/default/solvency prediction; individual credit and company bankruptcy differ, so this is a broad domain hypothesis

selection_policy: Exact membership and counts; no score-based substitutions or omissions. Distinct original source groups and input hashes required across all fourteen datasets.
validation_policy: Both models select checkpoints on the same two validation datasets, averaged equally by dataset. Final equal-budget checkpoints are the primary transfer comparison.
